prohibited_items.page_desc: Important shipping guidelines on prohibited and restricted cargo.
prohibited_items.heading: Prohibited Items
prohibited_items.subheading: To ensure safety and legal compliance, the following items are strictly prohibited for transport. Please review this list before submitting your manual orders.

narcotics.title: Narcotics & Dangerous Drugs
narcotics.subtitle: Controlled Substances
narcotics.item1: Illegal narcotics, stimulants, and synthetic drugs
narcotics.item2: Prescription medicines shipped without license or prescription documentation
narcotics.item3: Hemp, cannabis, or products containing active THC compounds
narcotics.item4: Drug packaging accessories and consumption paraphernalia

wildlife.title: Endangered Wildlife & Plants
wildlife.subtitle: Environmental Safeguards
wildlife.item1: Live animals, endangered birds, insects, and rare reptiles
wildlife.item2: Animal derivatives: raw ivory, horns, tusks, skins, furs, or shells
wildlife.item3: Protected flora/plants covered under local laws or the CITES treaty
wildlife.item4: Specimens of wildlife preserved or prepared for collection

weapons.title: Weapons & Explosive Munitions
weapons.subtitle: Security & Safety Regulations
weapons.item1: Firearms, ammunitions, primers, gun parts, or replica weapons
weapons.item2: Explosives, fireworks, firecrackers, signal flares, and gunpowder
weapons.item3: Tactical gear, daggers, switchblades, bows, arrows, and crossbows
weapons.item4: Stun guns, pepper sprays, tasers, and other self-defense devices

adult.title: Adult Toys & Explicit Materials
adult.subtitle: Cultural Decency Guidelines
adult.item1: Sex toys, adult novelties, and explicit devices
adult.item2: Pornographic books, magazines, movies, and explicit digital media
adult.item3: Uncensored adult items banned or restricted by local customs departments
adult.item4: Goods containing high-volume liquids or batteries violating decency laws

legal.title: Legal Compliance & Customs Penalties
legal.p1: MVM Logistics operates strictly under the legal frameworks of cross-border customs regulations. Attempting to ship prohibited items may result in total package seizure by customs officers, immediate account suspension on our platform, and potential legal liabilities under international customs laws.
legal.p2: If you are uncertain whether a particular product falls under these restricted categories, please reach out to our support team via Telegram or WhatsApp prior to initiating a manual order request.

contact.about_text:
At MVM Logistics, we specialize in helping customers order products and deliver goods safely and efficiently between Vietnam and Cambodia. Whether you need assistance purchasing products, creating a manual order, or arranging cross-border shipping, our team provides reliable support every step of the way.

Our website makes it easy to submit an order request, track deliveries, and communicate with our logistics team. Customers can also contact us directly for personalized assistance with sourcing products, transportation, customs coordination, and delivery arrangements.

We operate two warehouses to ensure faster processing and smoother logistics operations: one warehouse in Vietnam and one warehouse in Cambodia. This allows us to manage shipments efficiently in both directions, from Vietnam to Cambodia and Cambodia to Vietnam.

At MVM Logistics, our goal is to provide a simple, transparent, and dependable logistics experience—from your first request to your final doorstep delivery. Please view our Vietnam and Cambodia warehouse locations below for more information.
